title.narrative: Global Shield Financing Facility MultiDonor Trust Fund

description.narrative:
"The objective of the Trust Fund is to support poor and
vulnerable countries and people with increased access to financial protection against climate shocks, disasters, and crises, through technical advisory services and integrated financial packages to address protection gaps, as well as building strategic partnerships"
